/bin/zsh -lc 'set -o pipefail

SLUG=$(jq -r .signin.org_slug docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/05-install-seed-test-instance.json)

COOKIE=docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/cookies.txt
: > docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/10-org-bound-workers.log
for n in 3 4; do
  echo "### mint org-bound worker $n" | tee -a docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/10-org-bound-workers.log
  MINT=$(curl -sS -b "$COOKIE" -H '"'content-type: application/json' -d \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"test-"'${SLUG}-w${n}'"\\\"}\" \""'$BASE/api/orgs/$SLUG/admintoken/mint-enroll")
  echo "$MINT" | jq '"'{worker_id, bootstrap_host, fingerprint, token:\"<redacted>\"}' | tee -a docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/10-org-bound-workers.log
  WID="'$(echo "$MINT" | jq -r .worker_id)
  BOOT=$(echo "$MINT" | jq -r .bootstrap_host)
  FP=$(echo "$MINT" | jq -r .fingerprint)
  TOK=$(echo "$MINT" | jq -r .token)
  dist/agent-center-ui-hard-gate-69d5b662-darwin-arm64/install worker --prefix "$PREFIX/worker-$n" --user-mode --service --worker-id "$WID" --worker-name "test-${SLUG}-w${n}" --bootstrap "tcp://$BOOT" --server-fingerprint "$FP" --token "$TOK" 2>&1 | sed -E '"'s/acat_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/<redacted-token>/g' | tee -a docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/10-org-bound-workers.log
done
for i in "'$(seq 1 20); do
  curl -sS -b "$COOKIE" "$BASE/api/orgs/$SLUG/workers" > docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/11-workers-poll.json

done
cat docs/acceptance/t1450-ui-hard-gate/logs/11-workers-poll.json | jq .'
